header.running_head: 3. Belief in the Events after Death...

blocks.tamil_translation: bridge. The first group among you will cross that bridge at the speed of lightning. The narrator of this hadith says, “I asked the Prophet ﷺ, “May my mother and father be sacrificed for you! “How will they cross as fast as lightning’?” He asked, “Have you not seen how lightning goes and comes back within the blink of an eye?’ “Those who cross after them will cross at the speed of the wind, after them at the speed of a bird, and after them those who cross quickly will cross that bridge at the pace of running young men. Thus each person's speed will be according to his deeds. And your Prophet ﷺ will be standing on the bridge saying, “My Lord, grant them safety!” Some of them, because of their meagre deeds, will be unable to walk on the Sirat-ul-Mustaqim bridge and will go crawling. On both sides of that bridge iron hooks will be hanging. They will be commanded to seize them; by the command of Allah they will seize some, and these will attain safety with scratches, while others will be thrown into Jahannam. “By Him in whose hand is the soul of Abu Hurairah! The depth of Jahannam is surely a distance of seventy years,” Hazrat Hudhaifah and Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrate that Rasulullah ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: بَيْنَمَا أَنَا أَسِيرُ فِي الْجَنَّةِ إِذَا أَنَا بِنَهَرٍ حَافَتَاهُ قِبَابُ الدُّرِّ الْمُجَوَّفِ، قُلْتُ: مَاهذَا يَا جِبْرِيلُ؟ قَالَ: هذَا الْكَوْثَرُ الَّذِي أَعْطَاكَ رَبُّكَ، فَإِذَا طِينُهُ مِسْكٌ
